title: Haa -Ye Hussain Haa-Ye Hussain Haa-Ye Hussaina
body:
Maa ki fughaan hai haa-ye hussaina
Gham ka bayaan hai haa-ye hussaina
Haa -ye Hussain haa-ye Hussain haa-ye hussaina
1. Sheh ke gham mein ashk bahaou karne ko matam hath uthao
Aati hai purse ke liye Fatima zehra - haa-ye Hussain
<<DIVIDER>>
2. Jaan hai apni naam tumhara toote dilou ka tum ho sahara
Har dil e Momin ne musibat mein pukara - haa-ye Hussain
<<DIVIDER>>
3. Ghar ko luta kar deen bachaya sar ko kata kar deen bachaya
Dafan bhi na ho saka zakhmi tera lasha - haa-ye Hussain
<<DIVIDER>>
4. Farsh aza ka mere makaan mein aaee hai zehra mere makaan mein
Quld bana mera makaan karta hai nouha - haa-ye Hussain
<<DIVIDER>>
5. Pyase gale per chalta hai khanjer roti khadi hai shah ki khahir
Kehke yeh behosh huwi saniye zehra - haa-ye Hussain
<<DIVIDER>>
6. Haye nabi per kaisi jafa hai pyara nawasa qatl huwa hai
Pyare nabi Ahmed e mursal ne pukara - haa-ye Hussain
<<DIVIDER>>
7. Aaj kahan per soye Sakina mera bichona aap ka seena
Ladli roti hai chale aaeeye baba - haa-ye Hussain
<<DIVIDER>>
8. Aa-ee hai ghamkhar aye Ali akber sheh ke azadaar aye Ali akber
Jo hai jawan matam e Sarwar mein kahega - haa-ye Hussain
<<DIVIDER>>
9. Shah ke gham me khoon jo bahega khoo'n jo bahega dil yeh kahega
Matam e mazloom to imaan'n hai hamara - haa-ye Hussain
<<DIVIDER>>
10.Nushrate haq hai matam e shabbir dengi dua-a-een khahir e shabbir
Nusrat e shabbir me dawar ka hai nouha - haa-ye Hussain
Azz....dawar Ali dawar
